release: Digimon Venom NXT v0.9.0 — Dawn Relay Story Mode
baseline: v0.8.0 Local Admin Console full source

final_targeted_recheck.scope: Acceptance, Story UI and map/audio tests after visual polish; final small label adjustment recorded separately.

acceptance_coverage: All 78 starter species can clear the opening directly or after limited live-command training.
Three complete campaigns use normal attack/skill/item commands through all eight badges and championship, then defense, intentional loss and reclaim.
Existing high-level parties keep their identities, strength, items, credits, and progress across entry and return.
Normal evolution to level 1 followed by free recovery and training can continue the journey.
NPC battle flee, stale turns, stale dialogue tokens, locked trials and remote/locked map gates are rejected.
WebSocket tests cover private actors and chat, no shared rival publication, failed-save isolation, restart, and legacy detention recovery.
DigiLab, DigiFarm and normal inventory operations remain available; early story rewards and companion awards persist on the ordinary character.

visual_review.renderer: Native pygame/SDL with shipped assets, headless surface capture
surfaces: Field, NPC sprites and map gates
Narrow-map NPC/gate label separation with connector lines
visual_review.reproduction_script: Provided in the separate Native Previews archive.
visual_review.note: Preview capture uses isolated engine-created saves; it is not a live Windows session or a replacement game client.

limits: Windows client/server executables were not built or run in this Linux environment. Rebuild both with BUILD_ALL.bat on Windows x64.
The optional live MySQL test and graphical setup-wizard tests were skipped; WebSocket persistence checks use the existing SQLite development path.
Audio routing and file integrity were checked; no target-speaker listening acceptance or performance/load certification is claimed.
Recent Story result cards retain 30 entries; cumulative stats, badges and championship progress persist without a designed ending.

final_polish_recheck.scope: Story acceptance, UI, map/audio and world performance after final label placement and dialogue Settings shortcut.
